subject: Creativity
title: IDEO's Shopping Cart: Design Thinking in 5 Days
description: One-minute skill: IDEO's Shopping Cart: Design Thinking in 5 Days.

hook.text: In 1999, ABC Nightline challenged IDEO to redesign the shopping cart in five days.

buildup.text: IDEO's team spent day one ONLY observing — watching shoppers, interviewing store workers, studying pain points.

discovery.text: They found the real problems: child safety, theft, navigation in crowded aisles — issues no engineer would identify.

twist.text: The final design was modular — removable baskets, better turning radius, child seats. Not futuristic-looking.

climax.text: The episode became the most-referenced design thinking case study in business schools worldwide — watched by millions.

punchline.text: Five days. One shopping cart. A permanent shift in how we think about design.

quiz.question: What did IDEO spend the first day of the shopping cart challenge doing?
options: Only observing shoppers and interviewing store workers
